title: NYTDaiquiri No2
ingredients: 1 small lime wedge or wheel, for garnish.
directions: Place all ingredients except lime in a blender with 1/2 cup ice, preferably in small cubes. Blend about 5 seconds. Pour into a chilled cocktail glass, straining out ice with blender’s lid (or for a particularly refined daiquiri, a sieve). Balance lime wedge or wheel on glass’s rim.
